title: PFCP: fix dissection of C-TAG and S-TAG IEs

notes.body: This fixes the DEI encoding, but the C-VID/S-VID split in 2 fields is wrong: they should be combined into a single 12 bits field. Unfortunately 3GPP 29.244 is unclear: are the 4 bits in octet 6 the MSB?

added 1 commit
  • 9e5d9b3e - PFCP: fix dissection of C-TAG and S-TAG IEs
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/227/diffs?diff_id=111766063&start_sha=56ac1244ecfae6a0ddd52f84b2082f98ed04f5bc)
In the last change I assumed that octet 6 contains the MSB and octet 7 the LSB, which seems the most logical.
